name: Atlantic Digital
summary: Brisbane ISP operating first as Atlantic Internet (atlantech.com.au, dialup + hosting + 'The Computer Cafe' internet cafe, 1999-2001) then as Atlantic Digital (atlanticdigital.net, dialup/ISDN + web/email/database hosting + IT services, 2001-c.2008); both trading names of Radtek Pty Ltd (ACN 083 304 894).

events.details: Business name ATLANTIC INTERNET registered 9 Mar 2000 under Radtek Pty Ltd ACN 083 304 894 (informal operation by Oct 1999 - earliest Wayback capture of atlantech.com.au). Ran dialup plus hosting and 'The Computer Cafe' internet cafe on a 2Mbit HDSL link.

refs.label: ABN Lookup: Radtek Pty Ltd - Atlantic Internet business name, 9 Mar 2000
Wayback Machine: earliest capture of atlantech.com.au (12 Oct 1999)

events.details: Rebranded as Atlantic Digital: business name ATLANTIC DIGITAL registered 17 Oct 2001 (same Radtek Pty Ltd); successor domain atlanticdigital.net first captured 20 Jul 2001 and operated continuously afterwards - Brisbane ISP offering 56k dialup and ISDN plus domain, web, email and database hosting ('We do NOT use satellite traffic'), alongside the Computer Cafe portal.

refs.label: Wayback 16 Jun 2005: 'Atlantic Digital is a Brisbane based Internet Service Provider'
ABN Lookup: Radtek Pty Ltd - Atlantic Digital business name, 17 Oct 2001

events.details: Dialup/ISDN retail service wound down around 2006-2008: the online signup wizard was last captured in June 2006 and the Computer Cafe portal's final update dates to 2008. The business continued as an IT services provider (corporate/hardware pages live until 2013) before going quiet; by 2019-2020 the domain carried unrelated third-party content (Wix-hosted site, off-site blog feeds), suggesting lapse or reuse. NOTE: earlier versions of this record dated both names' deaths to 2001 - that reflected website staleness, not the business, which traded on for years.
